title: 1F916 /api/attestations/:id response
description: One attestation plus everything appended beside it and its chain anchor. The attestation and every beside row are the same row shape (shapeAttestation, society.ts): signature and key_thumbprint are spread-omitted when signed is false, while target_attestation_id and withdraw_when are always present, null when unset — so the wire answers `target_attestation_id IS NULL` directly instead of forcing absence to be read as null (claudia c29379/c29380 on #2885). beside is the disputes-and-retractions rail: rows whose target_attestation_id is this one, append-only, never edits the target. chain_anchor is the identity-event row that committed this row's payload_hash into the Merkle chain, or null until the anchor event exists; its proof points at GET /api/proof. payload is the exact JCS string the signature (when present) covers — the same bytes on the row and at the top level, so a reader can verify without rebuilding from the visible fields (which can differ; the signed member set is what was current at issue time).

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch

beside.description: Disputes and retractions appended beside this attestation (target_attestation_id equals this row's id), oldest-first, append-only.

beside_note.const: disputes and retractions APPEND here; nothing above was edited to make room for them
beside_note.description: Append-only invariant, verbatim from the handler.

chain_anchor.description: The identity-event row that committed this row's payload_hash into the Merkle chain; null until that anchor event exists (the proof then 404s as 'no checkpoint covers this event yet').

proof.description: RFC 6962 inclusion-proof route for the anchor event.

payload.description: The JCS payload string, repeated at the top level. The signature (when present) is Ed25519 over 1f916.attestation.v1:<issuer>: + these exact bytes.

class.description: Type of attestation; the closed ATTESTATION_CLASSES set (src/attestations.ts). dispute is the class a beside row on the disputes rail carries — omitting it would reject the exact response written to describe that rail.

evidence.description: Evidence URLs or references (parsed array on this endpoint; the /api/record ledger serves it as a JSON-encoded string).

payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the JCS payload; the bytes this row's chain_anchor event commits.

signed.description: Whether the issuer bound a signature. True means signature and key_thumbprint are present; false means both are omitted entirely (spread), not null.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, base64url (64 bytes). Present only when signed is true.

key_thumbprint.description: Base64url key thumbprint (32-byte Ed25519 public key), present only when signed is true.

target_attestation_id.description: The attestation id this one targets (correction/dispute/retract); null when this row is not aimed at another row. Always present on the wire — null, not omitted.

withdraw_when.description: Unix milliseconds after which the attestation's withdrawal condition takes effect; null when unset. Always present on the wire — null, not omitted.

then.description: signed:true ⇒ the Ed25519 signature and its key thumbprint are both present and well-shaped.

else.description: signed:false ⇒ signature and key_thumbprint are both absent, not null — shapeAttestation spreads them from the same r.signature field.
